summary.intent: Finish trail 157 by building a deterministic agent-eval for Caliper's output (scored against the TypeScript 7.1 checker), then verify, push and link the resulting branch.
summary.outcome: A subagent built and committed branch feat/agent-eval-weekly (1deff81e) in a worktree, with 26 passing tests and 18/20 correct locally on antd and shadcn. The follow-up push failed (the link reported the branch missing), and the session ended while rerunning the push to see the real error.

repo: Caliper's weekly job builds only the CLI, not NAPI, so the agent eval reads the whole-output `extract --format toon` table plus canonical JSON diagnostics instead of the sessionComponentToon slice.

The agent eval scores answers against the TypeScript checker (apps/oracle/src/agent-truth.ts), never against Caliper itself. Outcomes are correct, abstained or silent_wrong, and the reader is a fixed policy with no model involved.

The policy abstains on degradedBy, warnings or errors naming the component, cut-short, opaque or unreadable types, possible inheritance rows hiding a prop, and absent components whose file has a diagnostic.

TOON gives only the declaring type's name, so origin questions (own vs inherited from @types/react) can't be answered without guessing and were dropped. Defaults and descriptions aren't checker truth, so they aren't asked about.
scripts/agent_questions.json isn't in `just lint`'s list, so it had to be formatted manually with oxfmt.
The worktree branch is named worktree-agent-<id> while the committed feature branch is feat/agent-eval-weekly, which may explain the push/link mismatch.

code.finding: Added --agent-eval (try/except-wrapped like the oracle); findings() now runs without a previous record so silent-wrong is reported on the first run; the summary table comes from agent_eval.markdown. May conflict with the three-tools-report worker's edits.
Passes --agent-eval and updates the header comment; zizmor is clean.
